record.original_question: If T(n) denotes the maximum number of critical periods that planar polynomial systems of degree n can have, is it true that T(n) >= C n^2 log(n) for some constant C > 0?

evidence.quote: Problem 14. Is it true that T (n) >= C n^2 log(n) for some C > 0?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Consider planar polynomial differential systems of the form
  dx/dt = P(x, y),  dy/dt = Q(x, y),
where P and Q are real polynomials with max(deg P, deg Q) = n. A center is an isolated equilibrium point surrounded by a punctured neighborhood entirely foliated by periodic orbits. For such a center, the period function assigns to each periodic orbit in the period annulus its minimal period, viewed as a smooth function of a transverse parameter. A critical period is a critical point of this period function (excluding the value at the center itself).

Let T(n) denote the maximum number of critical periods that the period function of a center of a planar polynomial system of degree n can have, taken over all such systems and all centers.

Question: Does there exist a constant C > 0 such that
  T(n) ≥ C · n² · log(n)
for all sufficiently large n?
artifact.category_tag: Critical periods of planar polynomial centers
artifact.status_search_result: Recent work on planar polynomial centers near a maximum number of cusps establishes the lower bound T(n) ≥ C n² log n by constructing Hamiltonian planar polynomial vector fields (of both odd and even degree n) whose period function has at least on the order of n² log n critical periods, via a perturbation method using vector fields with many cusp equilibria. This appears to affirmatively resolve the question, although the optimality of the bound remains unclear.

status_evidence.title: Critical periods in planar polynomial centers near a maximum number of cusps
status_evidence.snippet: Existence of Hamiltonian planar polynomial vector fields of odd and even degree having a center whose period function has at least n^2 log n critical periods, via perturbation of vector fields with many cusp equilibria.
status_evidence.claim: A lower bound of order n^2 log n for the number of critical periods of planar polynomial centers of degree n has been established.
